name: b4_lin_dw_grad_bfp_zero_m16_b3
description: B4 Linear weightGrad + biasGrad into m16 BFP grads, 2 calls, an input and a loss group in the zero state, live loss at absmax 1e-7 (the operand-wide E_top of both weightGrad operands). Zero groups (codes 0, stored = bias, E = 0) sit far above live data 25-30 binades lower: E_acc follows the groups holding a nonzero code, never a zero group's exponent (sections 13/14, zero groups), so the live bits survive.
